headline: New different-major agent upgrade guide split from the old guide
summary: Adds a draft agent guide for upgrades crossing a major version, mostly moved from the deleted agentic-upgrade.mdx. Duplicate checks and delivery move to shared.md. The CLI bundles this guide and gives it to the agent, so its wording shapes agent behavior, but it is draft documentation and the CLI changes are reviewed separately.
reason: Draft agent-instruction markdown, mostly moved text; it affects agent prompts rather than compiled code paths, and the relative paths match the layout the CLI copies.
